# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Columbia  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Titles:** Rev.  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>; Jonas  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

He is described as an extremely ugly young man with a big, loose-jointed figure and absurdly long legs. He has lank, tow-colored hair, green eyes, a big mouth, and large ears. However, he is so radiant in his happiness on his wedding day that nobody considers him plain.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Jonas is cheerful, friendly, and exudes a natural niceness. He likes to laugh and joke, and he easily forms warm friendships. He is sincerely dedicated to his religious calling and possesses a deep understanding and love for those around him.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)_

## Traits

- Ugly in appearance  <sub>[v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>
- Cheerful and humorous  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- Friendly and approachable  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>

## Goals

- Fulfill his religious ministry work  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
- Serve at a mission church on Patterson Street in the slums  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake graduated from Redmond College and later studied theology at St. Columbia. For a summer, he took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church, where he met Philippa Gordon and quickly became close companions with her while fishing, boating, and walking together. Although he resisted entering the ministry for a long time, he eventually recognized it as his duty. He visited Patty's Place frequently while studying, becoming a general favorite. After graduating from St. Columbia, he visited Philippa's parents at Mount Holly and won their approval despite initial reluctance from her mother. They were married in June, after which he planned to pastor a small mission church on Patterson Street in the slums.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c38 P5](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_
